methods.label: Measured spatial cast removal
methods.name: Measured spatial cast removal
methods.mechanism: Fit two selected-only affine chroma surfaces and remove their spatial slopes while retaining the selected mean colour.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Measured radial illumination correction
methods.name: Measured radial illumination correction
methods.mechanism: Fit log-luminance against squared distance from an authored optical centre and remove the fitted radial variation.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Gaussian patch palette transport
methods.name: Gaussian patch palette transport
methods.mechanism: Compute the symmetric Gaussian optimal-transport map between two selected patch chroma covariances and means.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
methods.prerequisites: Required reference patches must contain selected pixels; otherwise exact identity.

methods.label: Three-anchor palette constraint
methods.name: Three-anchor palette constraint
methods.mechanism: Project chroma onto the closest point of the triangle defined by two selected patches and an explicit target colour.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
methods.prerequisites: Required reference patches must contain selected pixels; otherwise exact identity.

methods.label: Measured circular hue redistribution
methods.name: Measured circular hue redistribution
methods.mechanism: Compute a selected hue CDF with a seam in the least populated angular bin and redistribute hue into an authored angular span.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
methods.prerequisites: Target must have nonzero chroma to define hue; otherwise exact identity.

methods.label: Chroma marginal copula remapping
methods.name: Chroma marginal copula remapping
methods.mechanism: Map the two selected opponent-chroma marginal ranks through logistic quantiles while retaining luminance.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Hue-dependent colourfulness balance
methods.name: Hue-dependent colourfulness balance
methods.mechanism: Fit log colour radius to first circular harmonics and remove its measured dependence on hue.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Cluster-residual palette recolouring
methods.name: Cluster-residual palette recolouring
methods.mechanism: Fit three deterministic Lloyd clusters and translate each cluster toward authored anchors while retaining within-cluster residuals.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
methods.prerequisites: Required reference patches must contain selected pixels; otherwise exact identity.

methods.label: Measured channel-response reconstruction
methods.name: Measured channel-response reconstruction
methods.mechanism: Fit channel regressions from selected below-threshold pixels and estimate above-threshold channel values from the other channels.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
methods.prerequisites: At least6 selected below-threshold training pixels, and an above-threshold channel to reconstruct; otherwise identity is expected.

methods.label: Kubelka-Munk pigment mixing
methods.name: Kubelka-Munk pigment mixing
methods.mechanism: Interpolate reflectance-derived absorption-to-scattering ratios and invert the Kubelka-Munk relation; this is a creative reflectance approximation.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Variance-preserving principal monochrome
methods.name: Variance-preserving principal monochrome
methods.mechanism: Project selected RGB covariance onto its dominant eigenvector and normalize projected variance to measured luminance variance.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Two-patch discriminant monochrome
methods.name: Two-patch discriminant monochrome
methods.mechanism: Solve a regularized Fisher discriminant from two selected patch distributions to separate their colours in monochrome.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.
methods.prerequisites: Required reference patches must contain selected pixels; otherwise exact identity.

methods.label: Isoluminant colour-edge lighting
methods.name: Isoluminant colour-edge lighting
methods.mechanism: Convert selected chroma differences unsupported by luminance contrast into a bounded luminance lift.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Selected error-diffusion tones
methods.name: Selected error-diffusion tones
methods.mechanism: Quantize linear luminance and redistribute quantization error to selected forward neighbours with Floyd-Steinberg weights.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Area-modulated photographic dots
methods.name: Area-modulated photographic dots

methods.label: Analytical exposure fusion
methods.name: Analytical exposure fusion

methods.label: Constant-Lab-chroma lightness lift
methods.name: Constant-Lab-chroma lightness lift
methods.mechanism: Lift CIE Lab lightness with a bounded bell while keeping Lab a and b fixed, then return to linear Rec.2020.

methods.label: Uniform-chromaticity cast translation
methods.name: Uniform-chromaticity cast translation
methods.mechanism: Translate CIE u-prime/v-prime chromaticity from the selected mean toward a target while retaining luminance.

methods.label: Robust group-lasso chroma cleanup
methods.name: Robust group-lasso chroma cleanup

methods.label: Geometric-median cast balance
methods.name: Geometric-median cast balance
methods.mechanism: Estimate the continuous weighted chroma geometric median with fixed-count Weiszfeld updates and remove that robust cast.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Compositional-geodesic colour tint
methods.name: Compositional-geodesic colour tint
methods.mechanism: Interpolate channel compositions along an Aitchison log-ratio geodesic toward a chosen target, retaining luminance.
methods.validation: Initial active/distinct-output, exact-zero, determinism, selected-only statistics/reference isolation, feather blending, finite HDR and UI control authoring tests passed.

methods.label: Fixed-energy lightness redistribution

methods.label: Dichromatic reflection subtraction
methods.name: Dichromatic reflection subtraction

fixes.issue: Four creative local methods retained a full-frame RGB target plane and allocated per-pixel vectors/sets.
fixes.change: Evaluate the same selected-only 7x7 stencil directly during final parallel blending using fixed-capacity stack scratch.

fixes.issue: Luminance-only Wiener cleanup retained four unused chroma/covariance planes.
fixes.change: Build chroma and cross-moment planes only for guided chroma.

fixes.issue: An empty selection still built method statistics and local planes.
fixes.change: Return exact identity before constructing any method context.

fixes.issue: The new sequential diffusion path bypassed the generic finite-output fallback.
fixes.change: Reject nonfinite candidate values and residuals before they can propagate; ordinary finite outputs retain the same formula.

fixes.issue: New patch-based operations could use zero statistics from an empty selected reference patch.
fixes.change: Explicit patch-validity checks return exact identity when a required selected reference patch is absent; the UI explains the prerequisite.

fixes.issue: A black target has no u-prime/v-prime chromaticity, and a neutral target has no hue for angular palette operators.
fixes.change: Return exact identity for those undefined target cases; ordinary valid targets retain the same mathematical operators.

fixes.issue: Finite dot-cell sampling could leave dark gaps at nominal white.
fixes.change: Explicit full-coverage white endpoint independent of the dot-cell phase; black remains exact black.

fixes.issue: Sequential diffusion bypassed the generic nonnegative final-output safeguard for signed working-space samples.
fixes.change: Apply the generic finite/nonnegative blend safeguard while preserving excluded samples exactly.

fixes.issue: Returning an unchanged pixel from inside a transform still passed through the generic nonnegative clamp.
fixes.change: Unavailable scientific-reference operations exit before per-pixel blending, preserving even signed source values bit-exactly.

limitations: These are explicit creative or statistical tools; not every operation is appropriate for every photograph.
New global statistics use at most8192 deterministic selected samples; local reference distributions use a bounded7x7 stencil.
Channel-response reconstruction is an empirical estimate and requires enough selected unclipped samples; missing data is not recovered.
Three-cluster palette recolouring and monochrome/contour/halftone methods intentionally alter appearance.
Existing full-window mean/regression methods still require full-frame scalar planes; the full native rendering memory issue is reduced, not eliminated.
